newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Thiessen rejects fixed exchange rate.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Thiessen rejects fixed exchange rate.

text.p: Bank of Canada Governor Gordon Thiessen said on Friday he did not forsee Canada fixing the value of the Canadian dollar in any way against the U.S. dollar.
"I cannot imagine, even with the North American free trade agreement, which is about trade and not about exchange rates, I do not see fixed exchange rates or monetary union, no," he told.

Thiessen made the comment at a foreign exchange conference in response to a question about the likelihood of Canada and the U.S. linking their currencies or entering into some type of North American monetary union.
